title: Steaen Gama
summary: Raleigh names Steaen Gama in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Steaen Gama, Viceroy of the East India. The printed spelling Steaen was not corrected. The yeere 1544 names no era and was not stored. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter III, §. VIII, sig. 180a–182b
